messages:
Meera: Alert from our SSO detector: pattern looks like coordinated sessions -> same relaystate, different principals, geo flips within minutes. Affected: 8 users + 1 service account. Seeing repeated MFA prompts reported by users. Pausing any auto-unlock flows.
sec-bot: RULE_FIRE: SSO_ANOMALY_CHAIN (id=7721) | match: impossible-travel + mfa-retry | hosts: 203.0.113.45, 198.51.100.12 | users: 8 | action_suggested: revoke_sessions, throttle_auth | ts:1965432055
Alex: Blocking 203.0.113.45 at perimeter. Added rate limit to /idp/callback and soft-block for suspicious UAs.
Alex: fwctl deny ip 203.0.113.45; waf rule add rate-limit path=/idp/callback threshold=10/min; waf yara block ua~headless_chrome
Jamie: IdP logs (okta-saml-proxy) show many SAML assertions with same relaystate and mismatched principals. Assertion IDs SAML-8257..8264. Lots of X-Forwarded-For that don't match envoy source IPs -> probable upstream proxy spoofing.
Sophia: Support: multiple customers called in about repeated MFA prompts and session activity jumping regions. All non-admin users except infra-monitor SA which we revoked earlier. We're drafting a customer msg template.
Nate: Checked KMS/CMK activity. No rotates, no suspicious grants. KMS logs look clean. Not seeing evidence of key compromise. Recommend not rotating CMK right now (will invalidate tokens).
Priya: Immediate containment plan: 1) revoke sessions for affected users + overlapping IPs, 2) require step-up MFA for console paths, 3) temporarily narrow service account write scopes, 4) enable detailed audit hooks for revoke actions and IdP responses. Who owns each?
Meera: Assign owners: Alex -> network/WAF blocks & session revoke execution. Jamie -> IdP log analysis and assertion replay checks. Priya -> RBAC temp changes + audit hooks. Sophia -> customer comms + support triage. Nate -> KMS monitoring and confirmation.
Alex: Executed revoke for identified users (cmd: redwood auth sessions revoke --users @sec-4217-list). Applied ASN block AS-64511 and tightened callback rate limits. See ticket SEC-4217.
sec-bot: ACTION: revoke_sessions by Alex @1965432158; block_ip 203.0.113.45 @1965432160; asn_block AS-64511 @1965432182; rate_limit /idp/callback 10/min @1965432190
Jamie: IdP deeper read: authnContext claims vary (some assert 'urn:okta:multi-factor' but without matching assertion timestamps). Some assertions replayed with small nonce diffs. Likely automated tool replaying partially cached MFA states. We're exporting assertion XML for sig verification.
Priya: Pushed temporary RBAC patch: removed write permissions from infra:deploy role for 24h and created admin canary group requiring corporate VPN. auth-config changes: grant_patch infra:deploy -> read-only; admin_console.allowed_networks -> corp_vpn_only.
Meera: Log everything: add audit hook to send revoke and IdP assertion verification results to sec-log-ingest and create an immutable incident record. No manual deletion of logs.
Nate: Added extra KMS logging to high-fidelity bucket (read-only for infra). Also standing up a short-lived SIEM rule to correlate MFA prompt storms + impossible travel for 72h.
Sophia: Draft customer comms ready for review: apologize, state affected sessions revoked, recommend re-login and checking recent activity, link to MFA guidance. Will delay external notice until we confirm scope.
Alex: Observed follow-up probing from different ASNs after initial block. WAF signatures caught headless browser patterns. Tuned block list and enabled jailbreak response for auth endpoints.
Jamie: Remediation checklist I propose: 1) rotate SAML SP metadata cert (short-lived) and require re-auth for all sessions; 2) force nonce validation server-side; 3) blacklist replayed assertion IDs; 4) increase failure backoff in Okta to mitigate MFA fatigue. Thoughts?
Priya: Agrees with nonce validation and blacklisting assertion IDs. Rotating SP cert is heavy but will prevent long-lived replay; schedule at low-traffic window and coordinate with partners. Also add RBAC guardrails so service accounts cant be used for console logins.
Meera: OK schedule cert rotate for 04/03 02:00 UTC. Jamie, coordinate with Okta and partners. Alex, keep ASN blocks and WAF tuned. Sophia, prepare the customer notice to go out after we confirm no false positives. Nate, monitor KMS and token issuance. Priya, create the RBAC rollback plan.
sec-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: incident=SEC-4217 | status=containment_in_progress | owners=[Alex,Jamie,Priya,Sophia,Nate] | started=1965432055
Sophia: Post-incident action items: update runbooks for MFA fatigue detection, add a playbook for proxy-spoofing detection (XFF validation), and create a weekly audit for session revokes. Assigning to DevEx + SecOps.
Meera: Thanks team. Keep thread updated with any customer escalations. We'll reconvene in 2h for post-containment review.
